description: Turns an uptime percentage such as 99.9 into the downtime it allows per day, week, month, quarter and year, or turns a length of downtime in a period into the uptime percentage.

downtime_hours.description: Hours of downtime, to get the uptime percentage.

downtime_minutes.description: Minutes of downtime, added to downtime_hours.

period.description: Period the downtime falls in. Defaults to month.

sla_percent.description: Uptime percentage above 0 and up to 100, at most 5 decimals, such as 99.9 or 99.95%.

name: uptime_calculator
title: Uptime and SLA calculator
